body.statement: Regression corollary: when \(\Gamma=1\), \(D_P=\{\Delta_P\}\), \(C_P(\Delta_P)=0\), and \(\mathcal I_P(\rho)=\{\Delta_P\}\) for every \(\rho\geq0\).
body.justification: This regression corollary checks that the frontier collapses to the standard identified ATE when hidden assignment distortion is excluded.
body.gap: This is a required sanity reduction rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: Software and applied analyses obtain the usual observed-law ATE exactly at the no-confounding benchmark.
